name: Mini VPS (Linux)
author: mistersuki@proton.me
description: A small isolated Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, Alpine or Arch) inside a server: you are root in it and type its commands in the Console (apt install...). It runs with PRoot, without any right on the machine.
startup: if [ -f ./vps-start.sh ]; then bash ./vps-start.sh; else echo "The mini VPS is not installed: reinstall the server from the Settings tab."; exit 1; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installs the mini VPS: PRoot, and the Linux system chosen (images of linuxcontainers.org) in rootfs/. A system
# already there is kept (its programs and files) unless "Start again from a new system" is 1.
set -e
cd /mnt/server
apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates xz-utils tar >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64 | amd64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "The mini VPS is only offered on x86_64 and arm64 machines."; exit 1 ;;
esac
DISTRO="${VPS_DISTRO:-debian/bookworm}"
NAME="${DISTRO%%/*}"
RELEASE="${DISTRO##*/}"

# Everything is downloaded in the folder of the server: /tmp of the install is small (100 MB on Wings).
WORK=/mnt/server/.vps-install
rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK"
export TMPDIR="$WORK"

echo "Installing PRoot..."
if [ "$ARCH" = "amd64" ]; then
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o proot https://github.com/proot-me/proot/releases/download/v5.5.0/proot \
        || curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o proot https://proot.gitlab.io/proot/bin/proot
else
    apt-get install -y -qq proot >/dev/null 2>&1
    cp "$(command -v proot)" proot
    mkdir -p lib
    for library in $(ldd "$(command -v proot)" | grep -o '/[^ ]*libtalloc[^ ]*'); do cp -L "$library" lib/; done
fi
chmod +x proot

if [ -d rootfs/usr ] && [ "${VPS_RESET:-0}" != "1" ]; then
    echo "The Linux system already installed is kept, with its programs and files."
else
    LINE=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://images.linuxcontainers.org/meta/1.0/index-system | grep "^${NAME};${RELEASE};${ARCH};default;" | tail -n 1 || true)
    DIR=$(echo "$LINE" | cut -d';' -f6)
    if [ -z "$DIR" ]; then
        rm -rf "$WORK"
        echo "This system is not offered for this machine: ${DISTRO} (${ARCH})."
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "Downloading ${NAME} ${RELEASE} (${ARCH})..."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$WORK/rootfs.tar.xz" "https://images.linuxcontainers.org${DIR}rootfs.tar.xz"
    echo "Unpacking the system..."
    rm -rf rootfs
    mkdir -p rootfs
    tar -xJf "$WORK/rootfs.tar.xz" -C rootfs --exclude='./dev/*' --exclude='dev/*'
    mkdir -p rootfs/dev rootfs/proc rootfs/sys rootfs/root rootfs/tmp
    chmod 1777 rootfs/tmp
    echo "nameserver 1.1.1.1" > rootfs/etc/resolv.conf
    echo "mini-vps" > rootfs/etc/hostname
fi
rm -rf "$WORK"

cat > vps-start.sh <<'START'
#!/bin/bash
# Starts the mini VPS: the Linux system in rootfs/, entered with PRoot (you are "root" in it, without any right on
# the machine). Type your commands in the Console of the panel.
cd /home/container || exit 1
ROOT=/home/container/rootfs
if [ ! -x ./proot ] || [ ! -d "$ROOT/usr" ]; then
    echo "The Linux system is not installed: reinstall the server from the Settings tab."
    exit 1
fi
# The DNS of the machine, so that apt / apk / pacman can download.
if [ -s /etc/resolv.conf ]; then
    cat /etc/resolv.conf > "$ROOT/etc/resolv.conf" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
grep -q nameserver "$ROOT/etc/resolv.conf" 2>/dev/null || echo "nameserver 1.1.1.1" > "$ROOT/etc/resolv.conf"
SYSTEM=$(. "$ROOT/etc/os-release" 2>/dev/null; echo "${PRETTY_NAME:-Linux}")
SHELL_BIN=/bin/bash
[ -x "$ROOT/bin/bash" ] || [ -x "$ROOT/usr/bin/bash" ] || SHELL_BIN=/bin/sh
echo "Mini VPS ready: ${SYSTEM}"
echo "Type Linux commands here: you are root in this system (apt, apk or pacman to install programs)."
echo "Its files: Files tab or SFTP, folder rootfs/. Port of the server: ${SERVER_PORT:-?} (more ports in the Network tab)."
echo "Type exit, or use Stop, to stop it."
export PROOT_NO_SECCOMP=1
export PROOT_TMP_DIR=/home/container/.proot-tmp
mkdir -p "$PROOT_TMP_DIR"
[ -d /home/container/lib ] && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/container/lib
exec ./proot -0 -r "$ROOT" -b /dev -b /proc -b /sys -w /root \
    /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/root USER=root LOGNAME=root TERM=xterm LANG=C.UTF-8 \
    PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin \
    SERVER_PORT="${SERVER_PORT}" SERVER_IP="${SERVER_IP}" \
    "$SHELL_BIN" -i
START
chmod +x vps-start.sh
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Done: the mini VPS is installed. Start it, then type your commands in the Console."

variables.name: Linux system
variables.description: The system of the mini VPS. Changing it only applies after a reinstall with "Start again from a new system" set to 1 (the files of the old system are then deleted).

variables.name: Start again from a new system
variables.description: 1: the next reinstall deletes the Linux system (programs and files of rootfs/) and installs a new one. 0: a reinstall keeps it.
